metadata.title: Data Lake Platform - Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for July 2026 lakehouse architecture, catalogs, open table formats, CDC, governance, and production operations

trust_tiers.primary: Official project, vendor, standards, or source documentation. Prefer for factual claims and current behavior.
trust_tiers.secondary: Tutorials, landscape reports, community references, and implementation examples. Use for framing after checking primary sources.

metadata.default_source_policy: Use official project, vendor, and standards docs first for table format, catalog, connector, and managed-service behavior. Use architecture articles for framing only.
